preconditions.description: The number of tiles n is an integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(x in (1, 2) for x in a)
preconditions.description: The input sequence a contains exactly n integers, each being either 1 or 2.

postconditions.description: The output sequence b is a permutation of the input sequence a.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for s in prefix_sums(b) if is_prime(s)) >= sum(1 for s in prefix_sums(p) if is_prime(s)) for p in permutations(a)
postconditions.description: The number of prime prefix sums in b is maximized among all possible permutations of a.
